name: Release v2.15.2
body:
## Changelog

Refer to the [2.15 Upgrade Guide](https://docs.nats.io/release-notes/upgrade-to-2.15) for backwards compatibility notes with 2.14.x.

### Go Version

- 1.27.3, which contains mitigations for CVE-2026-111943 by distrusting eMudhra intermediate certificates (#8798)

### Dependencies

- github.com/klauspost/compress v1.20.3 (#8798)
- golang.org/x/crypto v0.58.0 (#8798)
- golang.org/x/sys v0.49.0 (#8798)

### Fixed

General

- Allowed connection types are now correctly respected in auth callout setups
- Fixed a potential queue sub weight amplification in the sublist
- OCSP responses are now correctly bound to the certificate serial number

JetStream

- Restored v1 stream snapshots now correctly guard against excessive subject lengths, subject counts or block counts

Leafnodes

- ACLs on leafnode connections no longer override allow/deny lists to implicitly allow `$MQTT.>` permissions

MQTT

- OCSP verification for MQTT connections now correctly obeys the `ocsp_peer` option in the `mqtt` block

### Complete Changes

https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/compare/v2.15.1...v2.15.2
